title: associate task input
description: The task an adapter is asked to run. Portable: identical for every harness.

prompt.description: The task text handed to the lane.

checkout.description: Absolute path of the checkout to examine.

session_id.description: The mesh/ACP session id, or a generated id for a headless run. Keys the scratch and export dirs.

export_dir.description: Directory the run's walk.jsonl and statements.json are written to. Outside the examined checkout.

continue_from.description: Optional export dir of a prior run whose walk is loaded as given context instead of re-walking.
